as_told.title: Autopsy of Marco Chereze shows unknown bacteria

plain: This story is about Varginha, a town in Brazil where, in 1996, people say a strange creature was captured. A documentary filmmaker, James Fox, says two forensic pathologists, doctors who examine the dead, have recently come forward with physical evidence. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a specific autopsy report on a soldier named Marco Chereze. According to Michels, Chereze died after grabbing an alien being with his hands, and the autopsy shows bacteria. Michels credits two doctors, Dr. Janini and Dr. Armando. If true, it would mean there is medical paperwork linking a death to contact with a non-human creature.
